title: The Rain Metronome
youtube_title: The Rain Metronome | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Dahlia finds a rain ticking at three different speeds on the porch. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Dahlia shows Faye how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
